data.title: Eber Aplícano: "Irregularidades en Alcaldía de Choluteca superarían los L100 millones"
data.description: Choluteca, Honduras.- El alcalde de Choluteca, Eber Aplícano , aseguró que desde que asumió el cargo se detectaron múltiples irregularidades en la administración municipal anterior, entre ellas contratos presuntamente irregulares, documentos falsificados y bienes municipales que no han podido ser localizados. Las declaraciones del edil surgen luego de que una investigación especial del Tribunal Superior de Cuentas (TSC) documentara el uso de 13 exhortos atribuidos al Juzgado de Letras de Choluteca para embargar 32 millones 545 mil 791.88 lempiras de fondos públicos . Aplícano sostuvo que el monto relacionado con esos embargos no representa, según las investigaciones realizadas por su administración, la totalidad de las irregularidades encontradas en la municipalidad. “Cuando tomé posesión, hicimos varias investigaciones y de que había unos contratos irregulares, donde había falsificación de documentos, había documentos que todavía no habían sido pasados por donde tenían que llevar su trazabilidad, bueno, hay muchas irregularidades, donde todavía hay documentos que no tienen ni firmas de contrataciones y fueron pagados”, afirmó. El alcalde explicó que desde su llegada a la municipalidad informó sobre estas situaciones al departamento de Recursos Humanos y que posteriormente el Ministerio Público abrió una línea de investigación. “Cuando yo tomé posesión, yo llegué al departamento de recursos humanos y le manifesté a la abogada Katia, que tenía conocimiento de que habían unos contratos irregulares en lo que es la contratación de diferentes empleados, diferentes colaboradores que estuvieron en la alcaldía municipal y por lo tanto, pues, el Ministerio Público abrió una línea de investigación”, declaró. Aplícano aseguró que la actual administración ha entregado documentación a las instituciones encargadas de investigar las posibles irregularidades y que continuará proporcionando información cuando sea requerida. “Vamos a dar todos los documentos pertinentes cuando el Ministerio Público siga pidiéndonos y el Tribunal Superior de Cuentas”, manifestó. El edil afirmó que las investigaciones realizadas por la actual administración apuntan a un monto superior al relacionado directamente con los L32.5 millones de los exhortos examinados por el TSC. “Nosotros dimos toda la documentación y bueno, tenemos el conocimiento que es arriba de casi de cien millones de lempiras, no solo, no solo es de esos treinta y dos millones de lempiras”, señaló. Aplícano agregó que también se detectó la falta de bienes municipales valorados, según sus declaraciones, en aproximadamente 19 millones de lempiras . “Nosotros en bienes municipales no encontramos diecinueve millones de lempiras, o sea, los bienes municipales de la alcaldía municipal no encontramos diecinueve millones de lempiras, de eso también, eso también lo metimos en incorporación, ¿verdad?”, dijo. Entre los bienes que, según el alcalde, no han podido ser ubicados mencionó vehículos, maquinaria, computadoras y una perforadora de pozos. “Hay una perforadora de pozos que no aparece por ningún lado de Choluteca”, afirmó. Aplícano indicó que esta situación también forma parte de una línea de investigación, aunque señaló que los resultados todavía no han sido divulgados. El alcalde también cuestionó la forma en que se administraban y registraban los bienes de la municipalidad durante la administración anterior. “De hecho, esta alcaldía no tenía un departamento de bienes municipales, por ende, se compraban cosas y no se cargaban al sistema, no se descargaban”, explicó. Según Aplícano, la falta de un equipo dedicado de manera permanente al control de los bienes municipales provocó dificultades para establecer qué bienes pertenecían a la Alcaldía de Choluteca y dónde se encontraban. “Por eso, por ende, no tenemos nosotros todos los, todo el inventario de lo que es la alcaldía municipal”, manifestó. El edil agregó que existen bienes que actualmente no han podido ser localizados y que tampoco habría información suficiente por parte de funcionarios de la administración anterior. “Hay muchas cosas que nosotros ya no las encontramos, pues no, no, no, ni saben ellos, ni saben ni la corporación pasada de ellos, ni los regidores de ellos, o sea, del edil pasado”, afirmó.
data.translatedTitle: Eber Aplícano: "Irregularities in the Choluteca Mayor's Office would exceed L100 million"
data.translatedDescription: Choluteca, Honduras.- The mayor of Choluteca, Eber Aplícano, assured that since he took office, multiple irregularities were detected in the previous municipal administration, including allegedly irregular contracts, falsified documents and municipal assets that could not be located. The mayor's statements arise after a special investigation by the Superior Court of Accounts (TSC) documented the use of 13 warrants attributed to the Court of Letters of Choluteca to seize 32 million 545 thousand 791.88 lempiras of public funds. Aplícano maintained that the amount related to these seizures does not represent, according to the investigations carried out by his administration, all of the irregularities found in the municipality. "When I took office, we did several investigations and that there were some irregular contracts, where there was falsification of documents, there were documents that had not yet been passed through where they had to have their traceability, well, there are many irregularities, where there are still documents that do not even have contracting signatures and were paid for," he stated. The mayor explained that since his arrival at the municipality he reported these situations to the Human Resources department and that later the Public Ministry opened a line of investigation. “When I took office, I arrived at the human resources department and told lawyer Katia that I was aware that there were some irregular contracts regarding the hiring of different employees, different collaborators who were in the municipal mayor's office and therefore, well, the Public Ministry opened a line of investigation,” he declared. Aplícano assured that the current administration has delivered documentation to the institutions in charge of investigating possible irregularities and that it will continue to provide information when required. “We are going to provide all the pertinent documents when the Public Ministry and the Superior Court of Accounts continue to ask us,” he said. The mayor stated that the investigations carried out by the current administration point to an amount higher than that directly related to the L32.5 million of the warrants examined by the TSC. “We provided all the documentation and well, we have the knowledge that it is over almost one hundred million lempiras, not only, it is not only those thirty-two million lempiras,” he said. Aplícano added that the lack of municipal assets valued, according to his statements, at approximately 19 million lempiras was also detected. “We in municipal assets did not find nineteen million lempiras, that is, in the municipal assets of the municipal mayor's office we did not find nineteen million lempiras, of that too, we also included that in incorporation, right?”, he said. Among the assets that, according to the mayor, could not be located, he mentioned vehicles, machinery, computers and a well drilling machine. “There is a well drilling machine that does not appear anywhere in Choluteca,” he stated. Aplícano indicated that this situation is also part of a line of investigation, although he noted that the results have not yet been disclosed. The mayor also questioned the way the municipality's assets were managed and recorded during the previous administration. “In fact, this mayor's office did not have a municipal goods department, therefore, things were purchased and they were not loaded into the system, they were not downloaded,” he explained. According to Aplícano, the lack of a team permanently dedicated to the control of municipal assets caused difficulties in establishing which assets belonged to the Choluteca Mayor's Office and where they were located. “Therefore, therefore, we do not have all, the entire inventory of what the municipal mayor's office is,” he stated. The mayor added that there are assets that currently have not been able to be located and that there would not be enough information from officials of the previous administration. “There are many things that we no longer find, well no, no, no, neither do they know, nor do their past corporation, nor their councilors, that is, of the past councilor,” he stated.

data.title: Exhortos falsos abrieron la caja del Estado: sacaron L32.5 millones con documentos desconocidos por un juzgado
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La caja del Estado fue golpeada con documentos judiciales que, según las propias certificaciones de un juzgado, no tenían autenticidad. Una investigación especial del Tribunal Superior de Cuentas (TSC) documentó cómo 13 exhortos atribuidos al Juzgado de Letras de Choluteca fueron utilizados para embargar L32,545,791.88 de fondos públicos, pese a que ese tribunal desconoció su emisión, firmas, sellos y actuaciones. El informe No. 002-2026-DGSD-CSJ-C, practicado a la Corte Suprema de Justicia, revela una cadena de actuaciones que permitió que supuestas demandas laborales contra la Alcaldía Municipal de Choluteca llegaran hasta el Banco Central de Honduras y provocaran el retiro de millones de lempiras de la Cuenta Única del Estado. El TSC concluyó que existen indicios de responsabilidad penal. El mecanismo era directo: se presentaban físicamente exhortos ante el Juzgado de Letras del Trabajo de Francisco Morazán; estos eran tramitados sin que constara la sentencia firme, el acuerdo conciliatorio o el auto de embargo que supuestamente los originaba; posteriormente se ejecutaban los embargos en el BCH y los fondos eran trasladados a una cuenta judicial para terminar convertidos en cheques de caja. Lea aquí el infrome del TSC completo en PDF El TSC encontró que seis números de expediente correspondían en realidad a demandas contra empresas privadas, pero en los exhortos fueron modificadas las partes procesales para presentar a la Alcaldía de Choluteca como demandada. En otro caso se utilizó un expediente real contra la municipalidad, pero con cambios en los demandantes, el abogado y la cuantía. Otros seis números de expediente simplemente no existían en los registros del juzgado. La gravedad del hallazgo aumentó cuando el juzgado de Choluteca respondió a las solicitudes del TSC. Su secretaria certificó que 13 de los documentos examinados carecían de autenticidad y veracidad, desconoció las firmas y actuaciones atribuidas a su persona y confirmó que algunos números no correspondían a ninguna demanda laboral registrada. También estableció que el sello utilizado en los exhortos era un sello judicial obsoleto, sustituido desde comienzos de 2025. Uno de los casos evidencia la alteración de un expediente auténtico. El proceso 0601-2025-00012 correspondía realmente a una demanda ejecutiva laboral contra la Municipalidad de Choluteca por L4,321,508.17, respaldada por un acuerdo conciliatorio. Sin embargo, el exhorto utilizado en Tegucigalpa consignó otros demandantes, otro abogado y una cuantía de L2,823,606, cantidad que finalmente fue embargada en el BCH.En los seis expedientes cuyos números no existían en los registros del tribunal de Choluteca, los embargos alcanzaron L16,713,674. Los exhortos señalaban supuestas demandas laborales y, en varios casos, tenían como representante al mismo abogado, sin aportar las fechas de las sentencias, acuerdos conciliatorios ni autos de embargo que supuestamente sustentaban las ejecuciones.La ruta del dinero también quedó documentada. Los fondos salieron de la Cuenta Única del Estado No. 11101-01-000618-1 del BCH, fueron trasladados a la cuenta judicial No. 11101-04-000040-6 del Juzgado de Letras del Trabajo de Francisco Morazán y desde allí se emitieron cheques de caja. Los 13 embargos terminaron pagándose mediante cheques a favor del abogado que figuraba como apoderado legal de los supuestos demandantes y receptor final de los fondos. El propio TSC establece que estos hechos provocaron un perjuicio económico de L32,545,791.88 al Estado de Honduras y advierte que los desembolsos se realizaron a partir de embargos sustentados en documentos carentes de autenticidad y respaldo legal suficiente. Por ello, los hechos contienen indicios que podrían ser objeto de investigación penal. La auditoría también señala fallas de control dentro del Juzgado de Letras del Trabajo de Francisco Morazán. Los exhortos fueron recibidos, admitidos y ejecutados sin evidencia de una confirmación previa con el juzgado de Choluteca, aun cuando no contenían la documentación judicial primaria que debía respaldar los embargos. El TSC identificó además la participación documental de particulares, profesionales del derecho y servidores judiciales en distintas etapas del proceso: presentación, recepción, tramitación, ejecución y pago de los embargos. Según el informe, las circunstancias encontradas podrían ser indicativas de responsabilidad penal. El expediente ya fue remitido al fiscal general del Estado para que el Ministerio Público determine las investigaciones y acciones legales correspondientes. El TSC pidió valorar la actuación del abogado receptor de los fondos y la intervención de los servidores judiciales que participaron en el trámite de los exhortos.
data.translatedTitle: False exhortations opened the State treasury: they took out L32.5 million with documents unknown to a court
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The State treasury was hit with judicial documents that, according to a court's own certifications, did not have authenticity. A special investigation by the Superior Court of Accounts (TSC) documented how 13 warrants attributed to the Court of Letters of Choluteca were used to seize L32,545,791.88 of public funds, despite the fact that that court did not recognize their issuance, signatures, seals and actions. Report No. 002-2026-DGSD-CSJ-C, submitted to the Supreme Court of Justice, reveals a chain of actions that allowed alleged labor lawsuits against the Municipal Mayor's Office of Choluteca to reach the Central Bank of Honduras and cause the withdrawal of millions of lempiras from the State's Single Account. The TSC concluded that there are indications of criminal responsibility. The mechanism was direct: petitions were physically presented before the Labor Court of Francisco Morazán; These were processed without the final judgment, the conciliation agreement or the seizure order that supposedly originated them; Subsequently, the seizures were executed in the BCH and the funds were transferred to a judicial account to end up being converted into cashier's checks. Read the complete TSC report in PDF here The TSC found that six file numbers actually corresponded to lawsuits against private companies, but in the letters the procedural parts were modified to present the Mayor's Office of Choluteca as a defendant. In another case, a real file was used against the municipality, but with changes in the plaintiffs, the lawyer and the amount. Six other docket numbers simply did not exist in court records. The severity of the finding increased when the Choluteca court responded to the TSC's requests. His secretary certified that 13 of the documents examined lacked authenticity and veracity, he did not recognize the signatures and actions attributed to him and confirmed that some numbers did not correspond to any registered labor demand. It also established that the seal used in the letters was an obsolete judicial seal, replaced since the beginning of 2025. One of the cases shows the alteration of an authentic file. Process 0601-2025-00012 actually corresponded to an executive labor lawsuit against the Municipality of Choluteca for L4,321,508.17, supported by a conciliation agreement. However, the warrant used in Tegucigalpa recorded other plaintiffs, another lawyer and an amount of L2,823,606, an amount that was finally seized in the BCH. In the six files whose numbers did not exist in the records of the Choluteca court, the seizures reached L16,713,674. The letters indicated alleged labor demands and, in several cases, had the same lawyer as their representative, without providing the dates of the sentences, conciliation agreements or seizure orders that supposedly supported the executions. The money route was also documented. The funds came from the Single State Account No. 11101-01-000618-1 of the BCH, were transferred to the judicial account No. 11101-04-000040-6 of the Labor Court of Francisco Morazán and from there cashier's checks were issued. The 13 embargoes ended up being paid by checks in favor of the lawyer who appeared as legal representative of the alleged plaintiffs and final recipient of the funds. The TSC itself establishes that these events caused economic damage of L32,545,791.88 to the State of Honduras and warns that the disbursements were made based on embargoes supported by documents lacking authenticity and sufficient legal support. Therefore, the facts contain indications that could be the subject of a criminal investigation. The audit also points out control failures within the Francisco Morazán Labor Court. The warrants were received, admitted and executed without evidence of prior confirmation with the Choluteca court, even though they did not contain the primary judicial documentation that should support the seizures. The TSC also identified the documentary participation of individuals, legal professionals and judicial servants in different stages of the process: presentation, reception, processing, execution and payment of the seizures. According to the report, the circumstances found could be indicative of criminal responsibility. The file has already been sent to the State Attorney General so that the Public Ministry can determine the corresponding investigations and legal actions. The TSC asked to evaluate the actions of the lawyer receiving the funds and the intervention of the judicial servants who participated in the processing of the letters.

data.title: Arrestan en Bolivia al argentino Fernando Cerimedo, asesor de campaña del Partido Nacional
data.description: La Paz, Bolivia.- Fernando Cerimedo , argentino que sirvió como asesor de campaña del Partido Nacional en las elecciones que celebró Honduras en noviembre de 2025, fue arrestado en Bolivia al ser investigado por un ataque que sufrió su expareja. Cerimedo fue detenido en el aeropuerto de Viru Viru cuando llegaba a Santa Cruz procedente de La Paz, informó el coronel David Gómez. El coronel indicó que la Policía tuvo conocimiento de que Cerimedo y su expareja Nadia Beller tuvieron "en días pasados un problema de carácter sentimental", por lo que se desplegaron elementos para dar con su aprehensión. "En este momento (Cerimedo) se encuentra en la Fuerza Especial de Lucha contra el Crimen (Felcc), a la espera de que se tome la declaración informativa en presencia del fiscal y de su abogado, con la finalidad de poder también cumplir lo que establece los procedimientos y la normativa vigente", explicó Gómez. Cerimedo es investigado si tuvo "algún tipo de participación" en el atentado que sufrió Beller el pasado 17 de agosto en Santa Cruz. "en la investigación se confirmará o se descartarán las hipótesis", agregó Gómez. Imágenes de cámaras de seguridad muestran que dos hombres vestidos como repartidores se acercaron a las puertas de un hotel donde se encontraba. Uno de los sujetos disparó contra la mujer, mientras el otro le roba sus pertenencias. Beller fue llevada de emergencia a un centro médico, donde permanece hospitalizada con un diagnóstico reservado. Cerimedo fue uno de los rostros visibles en el búnker del Partido Nacional cuando se celebraron los comicios generales. Es fundador y director del medio digital "La Derecha Diario", además de crear su propia empresa de publicidad y marketing llamada "Numen" con varias sedes en América Latina. Asimismo, dirige su propia academia que ofrece cursos de mercado digital y político en Argentina, Chile, Colombia, México y Estados Unidos. Cerimedo se autodenomina como militante de la derecha mundial, y ha sido asesor de campaña de presidentes de este espectro político como Rodrigo Paz en Bolivia y de Javier Milei en Argentina. El asesor argentino no solo ha estado en polémica por sus discusiones con periodistas y militantes de partidos y organizaciones de izquierda. En Brasil fue señalado como una de las 36 personas acusadas de haber conspirado para impedir la toma de posesión de Lula da Silva en 2022, según un informe de la Corte Suprema.
data.translatedTitle: Argentine Fernando Cerimedo, campaign advisor of the National Party, arrested in Bolivia
data.translatedDescription: La Paz, Bolivia.- Fernando Cerimedo, an Argentine who served as a campaign advisor for the National Party in the elections held in Honduras in November 2025, was arrested in Bolivia when he was investigated for an attack suffered by his ex-partner. Cerimedo was detained at the Viru Viru airport when he arrived in Santa Cruz from La Paz, reported Colonel David Gómez. The colonel indicated that the Police were aware that Cerimedo and his ex-partner Nadia Beller had "in recent days a problem of a sentimental nature", so elements were deployed to find his arrest. "At this moment (Cerimedo) is in the Special Force to Fight Crime (Felcc), waiting for the informative statement to be taken in the presence of the prosecutor and his lawyer, in order to also be able to comply with what is established by the procedures and current regulations," Gómez explained. Cerimedo is being investigated if he had "some type of participation" in the attack that Beller suffered on August 17 in Santa Cruz. "In the investigation the hypotheses will be confirmed or discarded," Gómez added. Security camera images show that two men dressed as delivery men approached the doors of a hotel where he was staying. One of the subjects shot the woman, while the other stole her belongings. Beller was rushed to a medical center, where she remains hospitalized with a reserved diagnosis. Cerimedo was one of the visible faces in the National Party bunker when the general elections were held. He is founder and director of the digital media "La Derecha Diario", in addition to creating his own advertising and marketing company called "Numen" with several offices in Latin America. Likewise, he runs his own academy that offers digital and political market courses in Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and the United States. Cerimedo calls himself a militant of the global right, and has been a campaign advisor to presidents of this political spectrum such as Rodrigo Paz in Bolivia and Javier Milei in Argentina. The Argentine advisor has not only been in controversy for his discussions with journalists and activists from left-wing parties and organizations. In Brazil, he was identified as one of the 36 people accused of having conspired to prevent Lula da Silva's inauguration in 2022, according to a report from the Supreme Court.

data.title: Capturan a dos miembros de "Harold" investigados por matar una pareja en Rigores, Colón
data.description: Trujillo, Colón.- La Policía Nacional capturó a dos integrantes de la estructura criminal denominada "El Harold", investigados por el matar a una pareja en la comunidad de Rigores del municipio de Trujillo, Colón. Los sujetos, identificados como Santiago Emanuel Rodríguez Dubón y Javier Hernández Cáceres, fueron aprehendidos en Rigores entre la tarde y noche del pasado 17 de agosto. El comisionado de la Policía, Eduardo Lanza, detalló que los individuos tenían una orden de captura por el delito de asociación para delinquir. Indicó que esta banda delictiva está conformada por siete miembros y que opera desde 2023. Sobre los detenidos, mencionó que uno se dedicaba al tráfico de drogas y otro al sicariato. "Todos los miembros de esta estructura tienen tanto órdenes de captura por asociación para delinquir, o en su defecto por homicidio y asesinato, entre otros delitos", amplió Lanza. Además, señaló que "toda la estructura está vinculada con la muerte de una pareja en Rigores" ocurrida en enero de 2025 . Los esposos se conducían en una camioneta Chevorlet cuando fueron atacados a balazos, dejando a una persona herida. Sin embargo, los detenidos sostienen que no están vinculados con ese crimen y afirman ser inocentes. "Nunca en mi vida (refiriéndose a que no ha participado en hechos violentos). Yo el 21 de mayo salí preso de Olanchito", aseguró Hernández. Por su parte, Rodríguez expresó desconocer por qué lo capturaron. Los individuos fueron llevados a las instalaciones de la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI) para continuar con el proceso judicial. Cabe destacar que las investigaciones policiales apuntan que la banda "Harold" también se ha dedicado a invadir tierras en Colón, agravando el conflicto agrario de esta zona.
data.translatedTitle: They capture two members of "Harold" investigated for killing a couple in Rigores, Colón
data.translatedDescription: Trujillo, Colón.- The National Police captured two members of the criminal structure called "El Harold", investigated for killing a couple in the community of Rigores in the municipality of Trujillo, Colón. The subjects, identified as Santiago Emanuel Rodríguez Dubón and Javier Hernández Cáceres, were arrested in Rigores between the afternoon and evening of August 17. Police Commissioner Eduardo Lanza explained that the individuals had an arrest warrant for the crime of conspiracy to commit a crime. He indicated that this criminal gang is made up of seven members and has been operating since 2023. Regarding the detainees, he mentioned that one was dedicated to drug trafficking and another to hitmen. "All members of this structure have arrest warrants for association to commit a crime, or failing that for homicide and murder, among other crimes," Lanza added. In addition, he noted that "the entire structure is linked to the death of a couple in Rigores" that occurred in January 2025. The couple were driving in a Chevorlet truck when they were attacked by gunfire, leaving one person injured. However, the detainees maintain that they are not linked to that crime and claim to be innocent. "Never in my life (referring to the fact that he has not participated in violent acts). On May 21, I was arrested in Olanchito," said Hernández. For his part, Rodríguez expressed ignorance of why he was captured. The individuals were taken to the facilities of the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI) to continue with the judicial process. It should be noted that police investigations indicate that the "Harold" gang has also dedicated itself to invading land in Colón, aggravating the agrarian conflict in this area.

data.title: “Mi corazón está destrozado”: Claudette McNiel llora el asesinato de su hijo Dereck
data.description: Roatán, Honduras.- La abogada hondureña Claudette McNiel expresó el profundo dolor que enfrenta tras el asesinato de su hijo, Dereck McNeil James , ocurrido en Roatán, Islas de la Bahía, y recordó al joven como una persona cuya vida permanecerá presente en su memoria. A través de un mensaje cargado de dolor y fe, McNiel aseguró que perder a un hijo de una manera violenta es un sufrimiento que ninguna madre debería experimentar. “Hoy mi corazón está destrozado. Perder a un hijo de una manera tan violenta es un dolor que ninguna madre debería conocer”, manifestó la abogada, quien reconoció que en medio de la tragedia hay momentos en los que no encuentra palabras y solo puede llorar y hacerse preguntas. Pese al dolor provocado por la muerte de su hijo, McNiel afirmó que mantiene su confianza en Dios y pidió fortaleza para enfrentar la ausencia de Dereck. “No entiendo sus caminos, pero confío en que Él sostiene a mi hijo en sus brazos y que algún día volveremos a encontrarnos”, expresó. En su mensaje, la madre de Dereck también aseguró que su hijo permanecerá vivo en su recuerdo y que su nombre continuará siendo pronunciado con amor. “Mi hijo vivirá para siempre en mi corazón. Su vida no será olvidada, su nombre seguirá siendo pronunciado con amor y su recuerdo será parte de mí hasta el último día”, afirmó. McNiel también pidió a Dios que le permita sanar poco a poco el dolor provocado por la pérdida y que la injusticia no la aparte de su fe. “Señor, recibe a mi hijo en tu gloria y dame la fortaleza para aprender a vivir con su ausencia. En tus manos lo dejo, porque sé que tus brazos son más grandes que mi dolor”, concluyó. Hasta el momento, no se conocen mayores detalles de las circunstancias del crimen ni quienes serían los responsables del hecho.
data.translatedTitle: “My heart is broken”: Claudette McNiel mourns the murder of her son Dereck
data.translatedDescription: Roatán, Honduras.- Honduran lawyer Claudette McNiel expressed the deep pain she faces after the murder of her son, Dereck McNeil James, which occurred in Roatán, Bay Islands, and remembered the young man as a person whose life will remain present in her memory. Through a message full of pain and faith, McNiel assured that losing a child in a violent way is a suffering that no mother should experience. "Today my heart is destroyed. Losing a child in such a violent way is a pain that no mother should know," said the lawyer, who acknowledged that in the midst of tragedy there are moments when she cannot find words and can only cry and ask herself questions. Despite the pain caused by the death of his son, McNiel stated that he maintains his trust in God and asked for strength to face Dereck's absence. “I don't understand His ways, but I trust that He holds my son in His arms and that one day we will meet again,” she said. In her message, Dereck's mother also assured that her son will remain alive in her memory and that his name will continue to be spoken with love. "My son will live forever in my heart. His life will not be forgotten, his name will continue to be pronounced with love and his memory will be part of me until the last day," she said. McNiel also asked God to allow her to slowly heal the pain caused by the loss and that injustice not separate her from her faith. "Lord, receive my son in your glory and give me the strength to learn to live with his absence. I leave him in your hands, because I know that your arms are bigger than my pain," he concluded. So far, no further details are known about the circumstances of the crime or who would be responsible for it.

data.title: "No lo esperábamos": Leda García Pagán sobre el fin del TPS para hondureños
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La secretaria de Derechos Humanos, Leda García Pagán , se pronunció respecto a la publicación del Gobierno de Estados Unidos en la que reitera que el Estatus de Protección Temporal (TPS) para hondureños está cancelado y que estos están sujetos a ser deportados. "Personalmente, voy a hablar por Leda García, no esperábamos que el presidente de los Estados Unidos nos dejara sin la posibilidad de poder abogar por nuestros hermanos", declaró la funcionaria ante medios de comunicación. El pasado 16 de agosto, el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional de Estados Unidos (DHS, por sus siglas en inglés) publicó en su cuenta de X un listado de los países a los que se les terminó el TPS, enviando una advertencia a los exbeneficiarios diciéndoles "salga ahora o será deportado". García Pagán responsabilizó al Gobierno de Xiomara Castro (2022-2026) de la no extensión del TPS para los compatriotas, atribuyendo que el tono confrontativo que mantuvo con Estados Unidos influyó para que el estatus migratorio no fue ampliado. "El año pasado, las decisiones que se tomaron, por las razones que hayan sido, hoy un, año después, estamos nosotros, todo el pueblo hondureño y especialmente los que están en Estados Unidos, sufriendo las consecuencias de las malas decisiones y de la falta de respeto en la interlocución hacia el exterior", dijo. Agregó que "al final lo que hicieron (refiriéndose al Gobierno de Libertad y Refundación) durante sus cuatro años es lo que orilló a tomar una decisión de este tipo, pero sí hubiéramos soñado, aspirado, anhelado, a que nos permitieran seguir luchando". La titular de la Secretaría de Derechos Humanos fue consultada sobre por qué la actual administración de Nasry Asfura no consiguió negociar el TPS, considerando su cercanía con el mandatario estadounidense Donald Trump. Ante ello, García respondió: "todos teníamos esa ilusión, esa aspiración. Son temas que no conozco, de los que no me puedo expresar. Solamente debo decir que lo lamento". El DHS confirmó en julio de 2025 la finalización del TPS para ciudadanos hondureños, argumentando que el país centroamericano ya no se encontraba en las mismas condiciones de hace más de 20 años cuando el huracán Mitch dejó desastres. Organizaciones y tepesianos hondureños y de otros países entablaron un litigio contra la cancelación del TPS. El 31 de diciembre de 2025, la jueza Trina Thompson declaró ilegal la anulación del TPS. Sin embargo, el pasado 9 de febrero el Tribunal de Apelaciones del Noveno Circuito de San Francisco suspendió la sentencia de la jueza Thompson que bloqueaba la anulación del TPS para hondureños, nepalíes y nicaragüenses.
data.translatedTitle: "We did not expect it": Leda García Pagán on the end of TPS for Hondurans
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The Secretary of Human Rights, Leda García Pagán, spoke regarding the publication of the United States Government in which it reiterates that the Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hondurans is canceled and that they are subject to being deported. "Personally, I am going to speak for Leda García, we did not expect that the president of the United States would leave us without the possibility of being able to advocate for our brothers," the official declared before the media. On August 16, the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) published on its García Pagán blamed the Government of Xiomara Castro (2022-2026) for not extending the TPS for compatriots, attributing that the confrontational tone it maintained with the United States influenced the fact that the immigration status was not expanded. "Last year, the decisions that were made, for whatever reasons, today, a year later, we, the entire Honduran people and especially those in the United States, are suffering the consequences of bad decisions and the lack of respect in dialogue abroad," he said. He added that "in the end what they did (referring to the Freedom and Refoundation Government) during their four years is what led them to make a decision of this type, but we would have dreamed, aspired, longed for them to allow us to continue fighting." The head of the Human Rights Secretariat was asked why the current Nasry Asfura administration failed to negotiate the TPS, considering its closeness to US President Donald Trump. To this, García responded: "we all had that hope, that aspiration. These are issues that I don't know, that I can't express myself about. I just have to say that I'm sorry." In July 2025, the DHS confirmed the end of TPS for Honduran citizens, arguing that the Central American country was no longer in the same conditions as more than 20 years ago when Hurricane Mitch left disasters. Organizations and Tepesians from Honduras and other countries filed a lawsuit against the cancellation of TPS. On December 31, 2025, Judge Trina Thompson declared the revocation of TPS illegal. However, on February 9, the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals in San Francisco suspended Judge Thompson's ruling that blocked the annulment of TPS for Hondurans, Nepalis and Nicaraguans.

data.title: Shakira reconstruirá la universidad y diez colegios afectados por el terremoto en Chocó
data.description: Chocó, Colombia.- La cantante colombiana Shakira anunció este lunes que reconstruirá la Universidad Tecnológica del Chocó, dañada por el terremoto que sacudió a Colombia el pasado 10 de agosto, y que junto al filántropo estadounidense Howard Graham Buffett impulsará la construcción de diez nuevos colegios en el departamento. "Voy a dedicar todos mis esfuerzos personales a reconstruir la Universidad Tecnológica del Chocó (...) Howard va a ayudarnos con (la Fundación) Pies Descalzos a construir diez escuelas nuevas en el Chocó, por eso era tan importante traerlo, por eso era tan importante venir hoy", dijo Shakira a periodistas en una visita con Buffett a Quibdó, capital del Chocó. La cantante señaló que "cada día que los niños no van a la escuela, es un día en que pausamos su futuro, y eso no lo podemos permitir". Shakira explicó que por iniciativa suya, el movimiento Global Citizen aportará 500.000 dólares y la promotora de conciertos Live Nation dará otros 500.000, para un total de un millón de dólares que serán destinados a la reconstrucción de las escuelas destruidas por el terremoto. La artista también hizo un llamamiento a los Gobiernos de Canadá, Japón y Reino Unido, así como al sector privado y a otras fundaciones, para que se sumen a los esfuerzos de recuperación del Chocó. Durante su visita, Shakira aseguró que el departamento arrastra una "deuda histórica" y advirtió de que la emergencia no debe terminar cuando pase la atención inicial de la tragedia, que en el Chocó deja al menos 13 personas muertas, miles de damnificados y centenares de viviendas y otras edificaciones destruidas o dañadas. "Lo que más me preocupa es que después de que pase el estado de emergencia (...) queden tantas personas en el olvido y damnificadas y nuestros niños no puedan volver al colegio", afirmó. La cantante destacó además el trabajo que desarrolla desde hace 22 años en el Chocó la Fundación Pies Descalzos, que ha permitido graduar a unos 400 estudiantes, de los cuales el 70 % ha continuado sus estudios en la universidad. Shakira recorrió junto a Buffett algunas de las zonas afectadas de Quibdó y visitó el Colegio Tecnológico Industrial Carrasquilla, el más grande del departamento, donde saludaron a niños que los esperaban y a la gobernadora del Chocó, Nubia Carolina Córdoba-Curi. Howard Buffett, a quien Shakira definió como su "buen amigo", es hijo de Warren Buffett, uno de los hombres más ricos del mundo, y ha destinado más de 160 millones de dólares a Colombia desde 2008, principalmente a iniciativas de desarrollo rural, infraestructura, sustitución de cultivos ilícitos, desminado y educación. El terremoto de magnitud 7,4 deja al menos 304 fallecidos cuyos cuerpos ya fueron entregados al Instituto de Medicina Legal (IML) para su identificación, mientras que la Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres (UNGRD) contabiliza 4.147 heridos y 194 desaparecidos, así como numerosos edificios derrumbados o con graves daños en su estructura.
data.translatedTitle: Shakira will rebuild the university and ten schools affected by the earthquake in Chocó
data.translatedDescription: Chocó, Colombia.- The Colombian singer Shakira announced this Monday that she will rebuild the Technological University of Chocó, damaged by the earthquake that shook Colombia on August 10, and that together with the American philanthropist Howard Graham Buffett she will promote the construction of ten new schools in the department. "I am going to dedicate all my personal efforts to rebuilding the Technological University of Chocó (...) Howard is going to help us with (the Pies Descalzos Foundation) to build ten new schools in Chocó, that is why it was so important to bring him, that is why it was so important to come today," Shakira told journalists on a visit with Buffett to Quibdó, capital of Chocó. The singer pointed out that "every day that children do not go to school is a day in which we pause their future, and we cannot allow that." Shakira explained that on her initiative, the Global Citizen movement will contribute $500,000 and the concert promoter Live Nation will give another $500,000, for a total of one million dollars that will be allocated to the reconstruction of schools destroyed by the earthquake. The artist also called on the Governments of Canada, Japan and the United Kingdom, as well as the private sector and other foundations, to join the recovery efforts in Chocó. During her visit, Shakira assured that the department carries a "historic debt" and warned that the emergency should not end when the initial attention to the tragedy passes, which in Chocó leaves at least 13 people dead, thousands of victims and hundreds of homes and other buildings destroyed or damaged. "What worries me most is that after the state of emergency passes (...) so many people will be forgotten and affected and our children will not be able to return to school," he said. The singer also highlighted the work that the Pies Descalzos Foundation has been carrying out for 22 years in Chocó, which has allowed some 400 students to graduate, of which 70% have continued their studies at the university. Shakira toured with Buffett some of the affected areas of Quibdó and visited the Carrasquilla Industrial Technological College, the largest in the department, where they greeted children who were waiting for them and the governor of Chocó, Nubia Carolina Córdoba-Curi. Howard Buffett, whom Shakira defined as her "good friend", is the son of Warren Buffett, one of the richest men in the world, and has allocated more than 160 million dollars to Colombia since 2008, mainly to rural development initiatives, infrastructure, substitution of illicit crops, demining and education. The 7.4 magnitude earthquake leaves at least 304 dead, whose bodies have already been delivered to the Institute of Legal Medicine (IML) for identification, while the National Unit for Disaster Risk Management (UNGRD) counts 4,147 injured and 194 missing, as well as numerous buildings collapsed or with serious damage to their structure.

data.title: Honduras atraviesa el período más seco de los últimos años: “Si no llueve habrá caos”
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Honduras vive con intensidad cualquier evento natural. Con el fenómeno de La Niña se reportan inundaciones, mientras que con El Niño la lluvia se disipa y se vuelve escasa. Con la canícula la situación se agudiza, provocando sequía, hambruna y muerte de animales, principalmente en el corredor seco. Precisamente eso es lo que está pasando en este 2026, pues las estaciones pluviométricas del Centro Nacional de Estudios Atmosféricos y Sísmicos (Cenaos) evidencian que este es el año que menos ha llovido, al menos al revisar los registros desde 2022. EL HERALDO Plus, a través de información compartida por Cenaos, analizó los reportes diarios de lluvia registrados en cinco años en las 25 estaciones pluviométricas desde enero a julio. Los datos muestran que en este 2026, unas 17 reportaron menos lluvia que en el mismo período de 2025, mientras que 10 mostraban el nivel de precipitación más bajo de los últimos cinco años. Esto significa que este año ha llovido menos. De acuerdo con Francisco Argeñal, jefe de Cenaos, este impacto se siente más en los municipios del corredor seco, pues mayo, junio, septiembre y octubre son los meses más lluviosos en estas regiones, pero en los primeros dos meses hubo una disminución. “Cuando tenemos Niño, como en el caso actual, es que la canícula prácticamente empieza a principios de julio y termina a finales de agosto. Es decir, hablamos de un mes más con pocas lluvias o ausencia de las mismas. Y este año, el mes de junio fue bastante seco y el mes de mayo fue bastante seco en la zona sur y centro del país. Este escenario se parece más al que tuvimos en el 2015, con el efecto de un Niño fuerte también, como el de ese año”, advirtió el experto. Argeñal explicó que 2026 no es el año con más sequía en la historia del país (mencionó 1997, 2001 y 2015), pero sí de los últimos cinco años (desde 2022). Mencionó que todo depende de cómo se comporta “el chorro de bajo nivel”, que en términos meteorológicos significa que el viento se acelera sobre el Caribe provocando que caiga poca lluvia en la zona del corredor seco. “Y justamente pues cuando hay Niño se ha visto que ese viento se acelera y no permite que la humedad del Pacífico entre y genere nubes en departamentos que son los más susceptibles a tener sequía cuando hay Niño , que son Choluteca, Valle, Francisco Morazán, el sur de El Paraíso, La Paz, Comayagua y en general varios municipios del fronterizo con El Salvador”, detalló Argeñal. Las 25 estaciones pluviométricas están ubicadas en puntos estratégicos y miden la cantidad de lluvia que cae a 10 mil kilómetros a la redonda. Solo en Francisco Morazán , ubicado al centro de Honduras, hay cuatro. Por ejemplo, la estación de la 21 de Octubre indica que desde enero hasta julio de 2026 apenas hubo 276.4 milímetros de lluvia. Pero un año atrás, en 2025, fueron 286.6 y en 2024 llovió 534.8 milímetros, casi el doble. En 2022 y 2023 la cantidad de lluvia estuvo por encima de la reportada este año, es decir, ha llovido menos. Lo mismo pasó en la estación de Sabanagrande, que pasó de reportar entre enero y julio de 2022 un total de 1,115.6 milímetros de lluvia, mientras que en 2026 con la sequía apenas registró 211.9 milímetros. Según Nabil Kawas, físico y meteorólogo, en algunas zonas de Honduras ha llovido lo necesario para rescatar la producción de granos básicos y garantizar la subsistencia de la población, pero en el corredor seco las precipitaciones han sido escasas. “En el centro y sur del país nos llueven de 1,500 (milímetros) para abajo. De Tegucigalpa a la capital, el promedio anual es de 920 y 925 milímetros al año. Entonces imagínense lo poquito que llueve aquí, y además se reduce a 400 o 500 milímetros. Entonces tenemos los problemas que ya conocemos y que estamos viviendo en este momento”, lamentó. De acuerdo con el experto, el lugar donde más llueve en Honduras es La Mosquitia , donde anualmente caen 3,300 milímetros anuales. Seguidamente está El Cajón, con 3,000 milímetros. Estos datos coinciden con los reportes de la estación de Puerto Lempira, en Gracias a Dios, donde en 2026 aparece como una de las regiones con más lluvia. Lo mismo pasó en el resto de años analizados por EL HERALDO Plus. En la estación de Tela, Trujillo, Colón y hasta Omoa, Cortés, ocurrió lo contrario, los acumulados registrados estaban por encima del resto de años, pues sí ha llovido en comparación con el centro y sur. Según Kawas, cuando El Niño afecta a Honduras lo que normalmente ocurre es que las lluvias en toda la cordillera norte y hasta parte del occidente, disminuyen, pero “si llueve entre 2,300 y disminuye a 2,000, siempre van a tener agua. Es más, hay algunos cítricos que son los que crecen en esas zonas que necesitan suficiente agua, con 2,000 milímetros garantizan una buena productividad”. En el centro, sur, parte del oriente y el sur del occidente ocurre todo lo contrario. El Niño provoca sequía. En la estación pluviométrica de Santa Rosa de Copán, por ejemplo, la situación es crítica: en siete meses apenas ha llovido 55.9 milímetros, de acuerdo con los registros de Cenaos. En el mismo período de 2025 cayeron 904.1 milímetros, mientras que el registro más alto de los últimos cinco años ocurrió en 2022, cuando llovió 978.8 milímetros. En las dos estaciones de Choluteca, que sí ha reportado algunas lluvias aisladas, también ocurre el mismo problema y, de acuerdo con testimonios recopilados por EL HERALDO Plus, la sequía no solo está matando al ganado, sino que ya se evidencia una crisis alimentaria , pues los pobladores no tienen comida ni agua para subsistir. Debido a esta crisis hídrica, Honduras mantiene alerta en 124 municipios, de los cuales 75 están en alerta amarilla, a las puertas de pasar a roja. Así lo mencionó Nelson Márquez, viceministro de Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos y Contingencias Nacionales (Copeco) , quien aseguró que “se ha verificado que en campo la situación está difícil, y, por otro lado, el pronóstico climatológico, la perspectiva climatológica, nos dice que la situación más bien se va a volver más complicada”. Advirtió que “estos 75 son la mayor preocupación; fuera de ellos hay algunas pérdidas, sí, pero, debemos reconocer que sí las hay, algunas pérdidas en los cultivos, algún problema de acceso a agua potable”. Francisco Argeñal también se refirió a los municipios en alerta y dijo que esta semana se reunirán representantes del Poder Legislativo con el presidente de la República para determinar en qué municipios amerita subir las alertas. Adelantó que muchos en alerta amarilla pasarán a roja y algunos en verde subirán a amarilla. También se sumarán otros municipios que están en vigilancia, pero no tienen ninguna alerta. De acuerdo con los datos de Cenaos, la crisis por sequía golpea más fuerte el centro, oriente y sur de Honduras. En el centro, el promedio de lluvias hasta julio de 2026 fue de 55.1 milímetros, el equivalente a 20 milímetros menos que en 2025, cuando en promedio llovió 75.1 milímetros. En la región sur el promedio de lluvias fue de 75.1, mientras que en el mismo periodo de 2025 llovió 109.6 milímetros. También hubo un déficit. En el oriente pasó lo mismo: en 2025 llovió 100.8 milímetros y para 2026 apenas se reportaron 113.6. Según Kawas, esta crisis hídrica evidencia la vulnerabilidad en Honduras, pero también la poca planificación para contrarrestar eventos como las inundaciones o sequías. “Nos confiamos, no creemos, y simplemente nos dejamos ir y cuando ya tenemos el problema encima, queremos resolverlo de la noche a la mañana, y eso no es posible, porque una de las posibles soluciones en esta zona, por ejemplo, son reservorios de agua, ya sea lo que se llama cosecha de agua o reservorios fuertes, grandes, para la capital”, dijo. Otra opción es la construcción de represas, pero “ningún gobierno se ha preocupado por desarrollar esos proyectos”, ni siquiera en la capital, donde ya se han hecho estudios y la única que avanza es la de San José, lamentó. Kawas recordó que “la ciudad capital cada vez va en aumento. Antes éramos medio millón, después un millón, ahora estamos casi llegando a los dos millones, y el agua sigue siendo, Laureles, Concepción y El Picacho... y cada vez que viene el Niño, el problema va en aumento, cada vez va siendo más grande, y hablar de cosecha de agua, a estas alturas, si no está lloviendo, ¿de qué me sirve hacer un hueco ahí en mi finca o en mi lugar para poder guardar agua? ¿Qué agua voy a guardar si no está lloviendo?”, condenó. Para poder recuperar los niveles de las represas en el Distrito Central se necesita que llueva al menos 20 milímetros cada cinco días, de acuerdo con análisis del jefe de Cenaos. Esto garantizaría abastecimiento para el resto del año, pero no para 2027. Joaquín Gómez, jefe de la Estación Meteorológica de la Universidad Autónoma de Honduras (UNAH) , coincidió con Argeñal y dijo que se tiene esperanza que al terminar la canícula las lluvias sean más frecuentes en el corredor seco, de lo contrario “si este Niño realmente provoca más sequía y no llueve lo necesario, sencillamente va a haber un caos el próximo año con respecto al suministro de agua potable en el campo urbano”. Gómez mostró preocupación por los bajos registros de lluvias en el país, ya que se reporta pérdidas de cultivos y los niveles de las represas están bajos. Desde la UNAH temen que como El Niño se prolongará hasta 2027 todo se siga intensificando. Recordó que con El Niño la cantidad de ciclones tropicales que se forman en el Caribe y en el Atlántico son bastante mínimos, pero que en septiembre esperan que sean mayor cerca del Golfo de Honduras , del Darién o de México. “Esperamos algún efecto de algún ciclón tropical del Pacífico y tal vez tengamos alguna entrada de humedad desde el Pacífico hasta la parte central y podamos tener presencia de precipitaciones y formación de nubes de tormenta. Eso es lo que se esperaría en septiembre”, insistió.
data.translatedTitle: Honduras is going through the driest period in recent years: “If it doesn't rain there will be chaos”
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Honduras experiences any natural event with intensity. Floods are reported with the La Niña phenomenon, while with El Niño the rain dissipates and becomes scarce. With the heatwave the situation worsens, causing drought, famine and death of animals, mainly in the dry corridor. That is precisely what is happening in 2026, since the rainfall stations of the National Center for Atmospheric and Seismic Studies (Cenaos) show that this is the year that has rained the least, at least when reviewing the records since 2022. EL HERALDO Plus, through information shared by Cenaos, analyzed the daily rain reports recorded in five years in the 25 rainfall stations from January to July. The data shows that in 2026, about 17 reported less rain than in the same period in 2025, while 10 showed the lowest level of precipitation in the last five years. This means that it has rained less this year. According to Francisco Argeñal, head of Cenaos, this impact is felt more in the municipalities of the dry corridor, since May, June, September and October are the rainiest months in these regions, but in the first two months there was a decrease. "When we have El Niño, as in the current case, the heatwave practically begins at the beginning of July and ends at the end of August. That is, we are talking about another month with little or no rain. And this year, the month of June was quite dry and the month of May was quite dry in the southern and central parts of the country. This scenario is more similar to the one we had in 2015, with the effect of a strong El Niño as well, like that of that year," the expert warned. Argeñal explained that 2026 is not the year with the driest in the history of the country (he mentioned 1997, 2001 and 2015), but it is in the last five years (since 2022). He mentioned that everything depends on how “the low-level jet” behaves, which in meteorological terms means that the wind accelerates over the Caribbean, causing little rain to fall in the dry corridor area. "And precisely when there is a Niño, it has been seen that this wind accelerates and does not allow the humidity from the Pacific to enter and generate clouds in departments that are the most susceptible to drought when there is a Niño, which are Choluteca, Valle, Francisco Morazán, the south of El Paraíso, La Paz, Comayagua and in general several municipalities on the border with El Salvador," Argeñal explained. The 25 rainfall stations are located at strategic points and measure the amount of rain that falls within 10 thousand kilometers around. Only in Francisco Morazán, located in the center of Honduras, there are four. For example, the 21 de Octubre station indicates that from January to July 2026 there was only 276.4 millimeters of rain. But a year ago, in 2025, it was 286.6 and in 2024 it rained 534.8 millimeters, almost double. In 2022 and 2023 the amount of rain was above that reported this year, that is, it has rained less. The same thing happened at the Sabanagrande station, which reported a total of 1,115.6 millimeters of rain between January and July 2022, while in 2026 with the drought it barely registered 211.9 millimeters. According to Nabil Kawas, physicist and meteorologist, in some areas of Honduras it has rained enough to rescue the production of basic grains and guarantee the subsistence of the population, but in the dry corridor rainfall has been scarce. "In the center and south of the country we get 1,500 (millimeters) of rain and below. From Tegucigalpa to the capital, the annual average is 920 and 925 millimeters per year. So imagine how little it rains here, and it is also reduced to 400 or 500 millimeters. Then we have the problems that we already know and that we are experiencing at this moment," he lamented. According to the expert, the place where it rains the most in Honduras is La Mosquitia, where 3,300 millimeters fall annually. Next is El Cajón, with 3,000 millimeters. These data coincide with reports from the Puerto Lempira station, in Gracias a Dios, where in 2026 it appears as one of the regions with the most rainfall. The same thing happened in the rest of the years analyzed by EL HERALDO Plus. In the station of Tela, Trujillo, Colón and even Omoa, Cortés, the opposite happened, the accumulated amounts recorded were above the rest of the years, since it did rain compared to the center and south. According to Kawas, when El Niño affects Honduras what normally happens is that the rains in the entire northern mountain range and even part of the west decrease, but "if it rains between 2,300 and decreases to 2,000, they will always have water. What's more, there are some citrus trees that grow in those areas that need enough water, with 2,000 millimeters they guarantee good productivity." In the center, south, part of the east and the south of the west, the opposite occurs. El Niño causes drought. At the Santa Rosa de Copán rainfall station, for example, the situation is critical: in seven months it has barely rained 55.9 millimeters, according to Cenaos records. In the same period of 2025, 904.1 millimeters fell, while the highest record in the last five years occurred in 2022, when it rained 978.8 millimeters. In the two stations of Choluteca, which has reported some isolated rains, the same problem also occurs and, according to testimonies collected by EL HERALDO Plus, the drought is not only killing the livestock, but a food crisis is already evident, since the residents do not have food or water to survive. Due to this water crisis, Honduras maintains alert in 124 municipalities, of which 75 are on yellow alert, on the verge of going red. This was mentioned by Nelson Márquez, vice minister of the Secretariat of Risk Management and National Contingencies (Copeco), who assured that "it has been verified that in the field the situation is difficult, and, on the other hand, the weather forecast, the climatological perspective, tells us that the situation is going to become more complicated." He warned that "these 75 are the greatest concern; outside of them there are some losses, yes, but we must recognize that there are, some losses in crops, some problems with access to drinking water." Francisco Argeñal also referred to the municipalities on alert and said that this week representatives of the Legislative Branch will meet with the President of the Republic to determine which municipalities warrant raising the alerts. He announced that many on yellow alert will go to red and some in green will go up to yellow. Other municipalities that are under surveillance, but do not have any alert, will also join. According to Cenaos data, the drought crisis hits the center, east and south of Honduras the hardest. In the center, the average rainfall until July 2026 was 55.1 millimeters, the equivalent of 20 millimeters less than in 2025, when on average it rained 75.1 millimeters. In the southern region the average rainfall was 75.1, while in the same period in 2025 it rained 109.6 millimeters. There was also a deficit. In the east the same thing happened: in 2025 it rained 100.8 millimeters and by 2026 only 113.6 were reported. According to Kawas, this water crisis shows the vulnerability in Honduras, but also the lack of planning to counteract events such as floods or droughts. "We trust, we don't believe, and we simply let ourselves go and when we already have the problem on us, we want to solve it overnight, and that is not possible, because one of the possible solutions in this area, for example, are water reservoirs, whether what is called water harvesting or strong, large reservoirs for the capital," he said. Another option is the construction of dams, but “no government has cared about developing these projects,” not even in the capital, where studies have already been done and the only one that is moving forward is San José, he lamented. Kawas recalled that "the capital city is increasing every time. Before we were half a million, then a million, now we are almost reaching two million, and the water is still, Laureles, Concepción and El Picacho... and every time El Niño comes, the problem is increasing, it is getting bigger, and to talk about water harvesting, at this point, if it is not raining, what is the point of making a hole there on my farm or in my place to be able to store water? What water am I going to save if "Isn't it raining?" he condemned. In order to recover the levels of the dams in the Central District, it needs to rain at least 20 millimeters every five days, according to the analysis of the head of Cenaos. This would guarantee supply for the rest of the year, but not for 2027. Joaquín Gómez, head of the Meteorological Station of the Autonomous University of Honduras (UNAH), agreed with Argeñal and said that there is hope that at the end of the dog days the rains will be more frequent in the dry corridor, otherwise "if this Niño really causes more drought and it does not rain as necessary, there will simply be chaos next year with respect to the supply of drinking water in the urban field. Gómez expressed concern about the low rainfall records in the country, since crop losses are reported and dam levels are low. From the UNAH they fear that as El Niño will last until 2027, everything will continue to intensify. He recalled that with El Niño the number of tropical cyclones that form in the Caribbean and the Atlantic are quite minimal, but that in September they expect them to be greater near the Gulf of Honduras, Darién or Mexico. "We expect some effect from a tropical cyclone in the Pacific and perhaps we will have some entry of humidity from the Pacific to the central part and we may have the presence of precipitation and the formation of storm clouds. That is what would be expected in September," he insisted.

data.title: Preminuo Frank Beard, jedini član legendarnog rock benda ZZ Top koji nije imao bradu

data.translatedDescription: Frank Beard, the longtime drummer of the iconic Texas rock'n'roll band ZZ Top, died at the age of 77 at his ranch in Richmond (Texas), surrounded by his family.

data.title: Norveški državni fond za penzionere ostvario historijski rekord: Nikada više nisu zaradili u šest mjeseci

data.translatedTitle: Norway's state pension fund achieved a historic record: They never made more money in six months
data.translatedDescription: The State Pension Fund of Norway (Statens pensjonsfond utland) recorded in the first six months of 2026 the highest half-year return in history measured in kroner, achieving a profit of 1,753 billion kroner (312.1 billion KM).

data.title: Hakerski napad u Latviji: Ukradeni podaci 1,2 miliona ljudi i 200 hiljada kompanija

data.translatedDescription: Data related to 1.2 million individuals and 200,000 companies were stolen in a major cyber attack on the Latvian Road Safety Directorate (CSDD).

data.description: Ljekari u bolnici u Trincomaleeu na istoku Šri Lanke prošle sedmice su operacijom uklonili kamen iz mokraćnog mjehura težak 3,1 kilogram kod 55-godišnjeg pacijenta.

data.title: Bivša sirijska vlada imala tajni nuklearni program? UN-ovi inspektori počeli iskopavanje na sumnjivoj lokaciji
data.description: Inspektori Međunarodne agencije za atomsku energiju (IAEA), nezavisne međunarodne organizacije pod okriljem Ujedinjenih nacija, počeli su iskopavanja na lokaciji Deir el-Zour u Siriji, za koju se sumnja da je povezana s nekadašnjim tajnim nuklearnim programom zemlje.
data.translatedTitle: Former Syrian government had a secret nuclear program? UN inspectors began excavation at a suspicious location
data.translatedDescription: Inspectors from the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), an independent international organization under the auspices of the United Nations, have begun excavations at the Deir el-Zour site in Syria, which is suspected to be linked to the country's former secret nuclear program.

data.translatedDescription: The red carpet of the Sarajevo Film Festival once again served as a perfect backdrop for top style, and Jovana Stojiljković stood out among the guests who captured attention with her appearance.

data.translatedDescription: There was no shortage of good times even on the fifth night of the Sarajevo Film Festival, when many citizens and tourists enjoyed the great evening atmosphere and facilities that Sarajevo offers during the festival days.

data.description: Nogometaši Dinama i Vikinga odigrali su na Maksimiru neriješeno 2:2 u prvoj utakmici play-offa za Ligu prvaka pa će se putnik u elitno takmičenje tražiti nakon revanša u Norveškoj.

data.translatedDescription: Dinamo and Viking players played a 2:2 draw in Maksimir in the first play-off game for the Champions League, so the journey to the elite competition will be sought after the rematch in Norway.

data.title: Država u državi: Kako fondacija porodice Rothschild upravlja privatnim gradom u Izraelu
data.description: Cezareja nije samo jedno od najvažnijih arheoloških nalazišta na Bliskom istoku, već i jedinstven socio-ekonomski fenomen. Riječ je o potpuno privatnom gradiću u Izraelu s 5.600 stanovnika. Njime upravlja privatna fondacija porodice Rothschild.
data.translatedTitle: A State within a State: How the Rothschild Family Foundation Runs a Private City in Israel
data.translatedDescription: Caesarea is not only one of the most important archaeological sites in the Middle East, but also a unique socio-economic phenomenon. It is a completely private town in Israel with 5,600 inhabitants. It is managed by a private foundation of the Rothschild family.

data.title: Putinova čistka pred izbore: Zabranjena jedina antiratna stranka, lider osuđen na 11 godina zatvora
data.description: Ruski sud je osudio istaknutog opozicionog političara Leva Šlosberga na 11 godina i jedan mjesec zatvora zbog javnog istupanja protiv rata u Ukrajini.
data.translatedTitle: Putin's purge before the elections: The only anti-war party banned, the leader sentenced to 11 years in prison
data.translatedDescription: A Russian court sentenced prominent opposition politician Lev Shlosberg to 11 years and one month in prison for publicly speaking out against the war in Ukraine.

data.title: Uspješna akcija GSS-a Mostar u Blagaju: Spašene državljanke Njemačke nakon nezgode na ferati
data.description: Pripadnici Gorske službe spašavanja (GSS) Mostar danas su uspješno okončali akciju spašavanja dvije državljanke Njemačke koje su, uslijed nezgode i pretrpljenog šoka, ostale zaglavljene na ferati Vulin potok u Blagaju. Srećom, akcija je završena bez povrijeđenih.
data.translatedTitle: Successful action of GSS Mostar in Blagaj: Rescued German citizens after an accident on the ferrata
data.translatedDescription: Members of the Mountain Rescue Service (GSS) Mostar today successfully completed the rescue operation of two German citizens who, due to an accident and the shock they suffered, were stuck on the Vulin Potok ferrata in Blagaj. Fortunately, the action ended without any injuries.

data.title: Bizaran potez izraelskog ministra: Hvali se izgradnjom sistema za vješanje zatvorenih Palestinaca
data.description: Krajnje desničarski ministar nacionalne sigurnosti Izraela Itamar Ben-Gvir izazvao je nove reakcije nakon što je na svom Telegram kanalu podijelio video koji prikazuje izgradnju namjenske jedinice za pogubljenje Palestinaca.

data.translatedDescription: Israel's far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir sparked new reactions after he shared a video on his Telegram channel showing the construction of a dedicated Palestinian execution unit.

data.title: U Domu penzionera u Tuzli moraju smanjiti broj korisnika, utvrđeno da je broj štićenika veći od dozvoljenog

data.translatedDescription: The pensioner's home in Tuzla found itself in the public's focus again after it was determined that it does not meet all the prescribed conditions for performing social protection activities, and one of the identified deficiencies also refers to the number of users that is greater than allowed.

data.title: Bazen rezervisan za crnce izazvao reakcije u Berlinu: "Ne smijem doći jer sam bijela"

data.title: British investor Ghai Sant Ram's HORIZON CITY project in northern Bucharest secures EUR 36 mln financing from Libra Bank
data.description: HORIZON CITY, the residential project developed by British investor Ghai Sant Ram in northern Bucharest, has secured EUR 36.5 million in financing from Libra Internet Bank. The total investment exceeds EUR 130 million. The financing provides the necessary resources for the building process independently of the pace at which advance payments are collected from buyers under pre-sale agreements. As such, it will allow for the acceleration of construction works, with full project completion targeted for the first half of 2027, six months earlier than initially announced, according to a press release. “For buyers, this financial structure means greater predictability and security regarding the accelerated progress of the project,” said Cătălin Apetri, CEO and Founder of CGA Home Consulting and Development Director for Romania for investor Ghai Sant Ram. HORIZON CITY is being developed on Pipera Boulevard, on a 23,000-square-metre site, and comprises 699 residential units arranged across eight stairwells and two development phases. The project provides 926 parking spaces, including 900 underground and 26 above ground. “We are entering an important stage of the project, in which the focus is increasingly shifting to installations, partitions and finishes. The financing we have secured allows us to plan the next stages very clearly, accelerate works wherever possible,” said Cristian Stanciu, CEO of the HORIZON CITY project. As construction progresses, the developer has finalized discussions with third parties and suppliers for the main categories of finishes and equipment to be integrated into HORIZON CITY. The acceleration of HORIZON CITY is taking place in parallel with the expansion of British investor Ghai Sant Ram’s portfolio in Romania. Recently, through Ghai Family Holding, he acquired from businessman George Becali a plot of approximately 30,000 square metres located near Pipera Plaza. The transaction was valued at approximately EUR 14.3 million, and the land was acquired together with the permit for the development of a large-scale real estate project. With 1,188 apartments at IVORY RESIDENCE, 699 units at HORIZON CITY, and approximately 650 homes planned in the recently acquired new project, the investor’s residential portfolio in Romania exceeds 2,500 units. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: press release)

data.title: SAI Globinvest launches ETF replicating Bucharest Stock Exchange’s reference BET-XT index
data.description: Romanian investment management company SAI Globinvest listed its second ETF on the Regulated Market of the Bucharest Stock Exchange on Tuesday, August 18. The ETF, listed under the ticker symbol GIBXTETF, aims to fully replicate the structure of BVB's reference index (BET-XT). Launched by BVB in 2008, BET-XT is a price index that tracks the performance of the 30 most traded Romanian companies on the BVB Regulated Market. Having a broader composition than the benchmark BET index, it offers a wider perspective on the evolution of the Romanian capital market. The BET-XT index components include representative companies from key sectors of the Romanian economy, such as financial, energy, pharmaceutical, industrial, and utilities. The total market capitalization of all Romanian companies included in the BET-XT index stands at approximately RON 438 billion, representing 60% of the main segment's total market capitalization, which exceeded RON 724 billion at the end of the day on August 17. In terms of yield, from its launch to date, BET-XT displays a 340% increase. At the same time, the first half of 2026 recorded the index's best H1 performance since its launch. Also in 2026, the BET-XT index surpassed the 3,000-point threshold for the first time, reaching 3.078,66 points following the trading session on August 17. Since the beginning of the year, BET-XT has appreciated by 46%. "With the launch of Globinvest's second ETF, we reach the milestone of 10 ETFs available for trading on the Bucharest Stock Exchange. This is a confirmation of our market's maturity and the democratization of investing through ETFs," said Radu Hanga, President of the Bucharest Stock Exchange. SAI Globinvest is a Romanian investment management company with 30 years of experience, founded in Cluj-Napoca. Within 16 months, Globinvest has brought two ETF financial instruments to BVB, the first being Globinvest Energy & Financials ETF, launched in April 2025, which tracks the performance of the BET-EF sector index and offered investors a maximum return of over 125% since launch. Net assets of the investment funds managed by SAI Globinvest total approximately RON 535 million. The initial assets of the GIBXTETF ETF amount to RON 4.1 million. The ETF benefits from liquidity provider (market maker) services provided by TradeVille , which also handled the admission of the ETF fund units under the ticker symbol GIBXTETF to the BVB Regulated Market. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: press release BVB)

data.title: Romania’s drone production capacities to rapidly increase in coming years, minister says
data.description: Romania’s drone production capacity will increase rapidly in the coming years thanks to private companies and public initiatives, said interim economy minister Irineu Darău on Monday, August 17, in an interview with Euronews Romania . The increase will be noticeable beginning with 2027, the minister said, thanks to the funds made available through the SAFE Act . Local drone production may also benefit from partnerships with Ukrainian companies . “There are private companies that are starting to innovate a lot in this field and already have foreign partners. I am convinced that all these joint efforts, private and public, will have an effect without a delay,” the official said. Darău noted that Romania has recently shot down drones that illegally crossed its airspace. While this has been done by military airplanes, the country will soon benefit from a drone-based defense industry. “We have entered an accelerated phase of innovation, and I am confident that very soon we will have a defense industry also based on drones that will help us. Firmly within the horizon of 2027, our domestic production capacities will increase rapidly,” Irineu Darău said. Drones have come to dominate the battlefield in Ukraine and have even been used by Iran in its asymmetric conflict with the United States and Israel. Russia and Ukraine have both relied on drones for close- but also long-range strikes on each other. The number of drone attacks recorded on Ukrainian territory, near the border with Romania, has exceeded 110 since the beginning of the war. In 39 cases, Russian drones were reported to have entered Romanian airspace, including the drone shot down on August 16 in Galați County, according to a Ministry of National Defense statistic consulted by News.ro . Since the beginning of this year, authorities have recorded 54 instances of attacks near Romania’s border. In 42 of these cases, aircraft from the Air Policing Combat Service were scrambled to monitor and verify the air situation. In approximately 50 cases, drones or drone fragments were identified on Romanian territory. The incidents took place against the backdrop of an unprecedented intensification, during that period, of drone attacks carried out by Russia against targets in southern Ukraine. The main targets were Ukrainian Danube ports, located near the Romanian border and the Danube Delta. The attacks also involved swarm launches, which explains the large number of drones detected by Romanian radars near national airspace. Some aircraft were intercepted by Ukrainian air defenses, and their fragments reached Romania or the waters of the Black Sea. radu@romania-insider.com (Photo source: Irineu Darău on Facebook)

data.title: Romania’s Enescu Competition introduces play & conduct format for 2026 semifinals
data.description: Semifinalists in the cello, violin, and piano sections of the 2026 George Enescu International Competition will perform as both soloists and orchestra leaders in a new “play & conduct” format. Introduced for the first time in the competition’s history, the conductor-free semifinals will take place at the Romanian Athenaeum in Bucharest in September. The cello semifinal is scheduled for September 5, followed by the violin competition on September 11 and the piano event on September 17. Six contestants from each instrumental section will advance to this stage. Each semifinal will be divided into two parts. First, at 10 a.m., the contestants will perform works by Romanian composer George Enescu, with free public admission. Then, the play & conduct round will begin at 4 p.m. and require a ticket. During this stage, each contestant will perform as a soloist with the Radio Chamber Orchestra while simultaneously providing the ensemble’s artistic direction without a conductor. The musicians will have to communicate their interpretation to the orchestra through gestures, eye contact, breathing, and movement while performing their own parts, the organizers said. They will be assessed on their solo performance, musical communication, and ability to lead the ensemble toward a coherent interpretation. Cello semifinalists will perform Enescu’s Cello Sonata No. 2 in C Major, Op. 26 during the first part of the competition. For the play & conduct round, they will choose one of Joseph Haydn’s two cello concertos. The violin contestants will perform either Enescu’s Violin Sonata No. 2 in F Minor, Op. 6 or Violin Sonata No. 3 in A Minor, Op. 25, “in Romanian folk character.” They will then perform and lead the orchestra in one of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concertos Nos. 3, 4 or 5. Piano semifinalists will select one of three works by Enescu: Suite No. 2 in D Major, Op. 10 , Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp Minor, Op. 24 or Piano Sonata No. 3 in D Major, Op. 24 . Their play & conduct repertoire will consist of Mozart’s Piano Concertos Nos. 20, 21 or 23. The Radio Chamber Orchestra will perform with guest concertmasters Adrian Iliescu for the cello semifinal, Deborah Nemțanu for the violin event, and Sebastian Câșleanu for the piano section. Up to 50 contestants can be admitted to the first stage of each instrumental section. Twelve will advance to the second round, six to the semifinals, and three to the final. Tickets for the afternoon sessions are available through Eventim and at Cărturești and Humanitas bookstores. Students, pupils, and teachers from music schools and universities can attend free of charge with valid identification, subject to availability. People with disabilities and their companions are also eligible for free admission, subject to available seats. The complete program of the 2026 George Enescu International Competition is available on the competition’s official website . irina.marica@romania-insider.com (Photo source: PR)
